trait.name: Immunities and Saves
entries: Ri'all automatically succeeds on all saving throws.

bonus.name: Spirit Wail {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 14}, each creature, excluding Thayan mercenaries, in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the cultist. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Ri'all casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ri'all makes three attacks, using Dread Scythe or Deathly Ray in any combination.

action.name: Dread Scythe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.
